page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-64 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 64 vCPUs and 512 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor with 32 physical cores and 2 threads per core, this server features dedicated CPU allocation. The processor architecture includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512, Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. No local NVMe storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory and multi-core performance. The instance achieves a read-only large-block memory bandwidth of 276.11 GB/sec and a write large-block bandwidth of 121.94 GB/sec, both placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. Multi-core processing is robust, as evidenced by a PassMark CPU score of 62,986.78 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,904.0. The hardware accelerators enable efficient execution of complex workloads, demonstrated by high throughput in PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations reaching 70.51 million operations per second.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core and strong memory bandwidth, this instance is highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise application hosting, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM prompt processing.
